title: Expressions: agreement with dplyr
label: Expressions
checked: The column each expression gives in mutate(), grouped mutate(), and grouped summarise(), on every backend: arithmetic, comparison and logic with NA, conditionals, rounding, strings, offsets, ranks, cumulative functions, and aggregates.

inputs.name: expression cases
inputs.detail: A 7-row table with NA in every column, defined in tests/Support/ExprCases.php and tests/r/expr.R

comparison.applies_to: Numbers on both sides are rounded to 9 decimal places with PHP round(), then compared exactly. Inf, -Inf, and NaN count as NA, because the JSON fixtures cannot hold them. NA must be NA in the same positions.

Numbers on both sides are rounded to 9 decimal places with PHP round(), then compared exactly. Inf, -Inf, and NaN count as NA, because the JSON fixtures cannot hold them. NA must be NA in the same positions. The verb must also run in Polars, with no fallback to a DataFrame.

exclusions: The round case is not run on SQL databases. SQL ROUND does not round half to even, so SqlTable always evaluates round() in memory.
reproduce: PHIBBLE_TEST_PGSQL="pgsql:host=127.0.0.1;port=5432;dbname=postgres" PHIBBLE_TEST_PGSQL_USER=postgres PHIBBLE_TEST_MYSQL="mysql:host=127.0.0.1;port=3306" PHIBBLE_TEST_MYSQL_USER=root php vendor/bin/pest tests/ExprTest.php tests/SqlTest.php
description: The fixtures were regenerated with these R versions on 2026-11-01 and were byte-identical to the committed files.
